# AIX Codecs

AIX Codecs provides experimental deterministic JSON serialization and strict decoding for AIX message payloads.

- Project: https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem
- AIX Core: https://github.com/PCakes303/aix-core
- Contract: docs/CODEC-CONTRACT.md
- Security boundary: SECURITY.md
- Reference implementation: aix_codecs/canonical.py
- Tests: tests/test_canonical.py

AIX is an extension layer over established protocols. This repository does not authenticate senders, authorize actions, provide transport, or claim production interoperability.
